def prepend_recent(existing, incoming, limit):
    return (list(incoming) + list(existing))[:limit]

import unittest
from recent_ids import prepend_recent

class RecentIds(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_extendleft_order_and_opposite_end_eviction(self):
        self.assertEqual(prepend_recent([10, 20, 30], [7, 8], 4), [8, 7, 10, 20])
        self.assertEqual(prepend_recent([10, 20], [7, 8, 9, 11], 3), [11, 9, 8])

    def test_initialization_has_its_own_capacity_rule(self):
        self.assertEqual(prepend_recent([10, 20, 30, 40], [], 2), [30, 40])
        self.assertEqual(prepend_recent([10, 20, 30, 40], [7], 2), [7, 30])
        self.assertEqual(prepend_recent([], [7, 8], 5), [8, 7])

    def test_zero_capacity_and_input_preservation(self):
        existing, incoming = [10, 20], [7, 8]
        self.assertEqual(prepend_recent(existing, incoming, 0), [])
        self.assertEqual(prepend_recent(existing, incoming, 3), [8, 7, 10])
        self.assertEqual(existing, [10, 20])
        self.assertEqual(incoming, [7, 8])
        self.assertEqual(prepend_recent([], [], 0), [])

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
